review_comments:
The `e` is an interface.
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/3e438c54a77ccf7b9e0aff924eb977031099cc2f/pkg/kubelet/cm/devicemanager/manager.go#L113

As shown in this error message, the key of `m.endpoints` does not exist.
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/121451

and causes it to panic, so we should check whether it exists before using it.

@pohly

the fix per se makes sense to me, but I'm not clear on the sequence of events which triggers `PluginDisconnected` with missing endpoint for a resource.

I tend to believe this fix is safe and worthy anyway, in general.
I think the bug is very clear
